newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ING-Barings said to lead Russia's Irkutsk Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: ING-Barings said to lead Russia's Irkutsk Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's Far Eastern Irkutsk region has named ING-Barings lead-manager of its Eurobond issue, an official at the region's financial adviser All-Russian Bank for Regional Development, said on Monday.

"The Irkutsk region tender commission considered the materials presented by commercial banks for the lead manager tender," Planning Department Head Yevgeny Petrov quoted an official letter from Irkutsk administration as saying. "It decided to name ING-Barings lead-manager."
ING-Barings is also a rating consultant for the $80 million Irkutsk issue, scheduled to be launched at the start of 1998.
ABN-Amro, Salomon Brothers and Societe Generale also applied for the position.

Two Russian regions, the City of Moscow and St Petersburg, have successfully tapped international markets. Several other regions, including Nizhny Novgorod, Moscow region and Tatarstan republic, are preparing Eurobond issues.
Russia recently made its third Eurobond issue of $2 billion.
